title: A Perfect Bike Ride and Cava Experience
text:
Best thing we did in Sitges!
We did this as a family and honestly none of us wanted it to end. I wasn't sure how a cava tour would go down with everyone but it ended up being the highlight of the whole trip.
The guide was brilliant — really relaxed and fun, not at all the scripted-tour type. He clearly loves what they do and that comes through straight away. Lots of laughs along the way too, which always helps when you're tasting wine at 11 in the morning!
